_comment: The organizations package's custom actions (docs/seo_analyzer_PRD.md X11), shipped as a library layer.
The classes are CustomActions/OrganizationCustomActions.cs; their rights are in this library's
security.json, and the role each needs inside an organization is the row policy's
([RequiresOrganizationRole] on the model classes). Labels are actions.<Name>.* in translations.json.
